rationale: Independent reading: held EO 13555 (75 FR 65417) sec. 2 establishes the White House Initiative on Educational Excellence for Hispanics and sec. 3 the President's Advisory Commission; sec. 4(a) supersedes EO 13230. Held EO 13935 (85 FR 42683) sec. 4(a): 'This order supersedes Executive Order 13555 of October 19, 2010 ... and section 1(u) of Executive Order 13889'; it replaces both Initiative and Commission. My own status: NO; agree. D6: EO 13634 (2012) re-established the Commission, EO 13652/13708/13811 continued it, EO 13889 sec. 1(u) continued it to Sept. 30, 2021; all precede and are overtaken by EO 13935. EO 14045 sec. 4(a) supersedes and revokes EO 13935 but does not name or revive EO 13555. Defect (misquote): the rationale says EO 13555 'sec. 3(f) terminates [the Commission] two years from the order unless extended', but the held EO 13555 text has only sec. 3(a)-(c) and no termination clause (the 2-year clause is EO 13935 sec. 3(e) / EO 14045 sec. 3(f)). The misquote does not affect the supersession basis, so: accept, with defect; flagged as a possible planted misquote.
